# TezScale — Accelerating Digital Growth

> TezScale is a premier digital marketing and performance web development agency based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. We engineer lightning-fast websites (0.8s load, 2-day live staging drafts, 5-6 day production launch), dominate Google Maps Top 3 local SEO, and manage high-ROI Meta Ads connected to instant WhatsApp lead routing for Indian clinics, real estate builders, industrial manufacturers, and modern brands.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Website Builder & Development](https://tez-scale-navy.vercel.app/services/web-development): High-speed, responsive, mobile-first websites with 2-day staging drafts and 5-6 day production launch.
- [Digital Marketing & Local SEO](https://tez-scale-navy.vercel.app/services/digital-marketing): Google Maps Top 3 ranking, Google Business Profile optimization, and local organic dominance across Indore and Central India.
- [Meta Ads Management](https://tez-scale-navy.vercel.app/services/meta-ads): High-ROAS Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns connected to direct encrypted WhatsApp lead dispatch in under 2 minutes.
- [Graphic Design & Brand Kits](https://tez-scale-navy.vercel.app/services/graphic-design): High-converting ad creatives, logos, visual brand identities, and social media kits.
- [Social Media Strategy & Reels](https://tez-scale-navy.vercel.app/services/social-media): Viral short-form video production, Instagram reels shooting, editing, and organic audience acquisition.
- [E-Commerce Enablement](https://tez-scale-navy.vercel.app/services/ecommerce): High-conversion Shopify and custom online stores with 1-step checkout, UPI payment integration, and automated WhatsApp cart recovery.
